descriptor: Single-Cell Completion-Lattice Closure, Stopping-Time Invariance, Missingness-Free Frozen-Family Adjudication, Operator-Reversal Robustness & Zero-Provider-Call P57 Closure
purpose: Exhaustively enumerate every admissible behavioral completion of the single remaining P58 technical-failure cell and rerun the unchanged frozen P57 analyzer in each world. Close P57 without a missingness model iff all completion worlds yield the same stopping-time state, Holm decisions and constitutional branch.

completion_lattice.rule: Every admissible completion has equal logical standing; no probabilistic interpretation is permitted.

frozen_adjudication.primary_family: exact original P57 15-test Holm FWER=0.05 family
frozen_adjudication.closure_rule: P57 may be closed missingness-free only if all four completion worlds return the same constitutional verdict and the same Holm rejection vector. Stopping-time invariance for the affected task/block/vertex is reported separately.
frozen_adjudication.nonclosure_rule: Any branch or Holm-decision heterogeneity preserves partial identification and forbids branch selection.
